name: Nanxun
queryAndRequestOutcome: Separate English and Chinese first-party discovery identified the Nanxun branch of the Huzhou Natural Resources and Planning Bureau and the Nanxun sub-center of the Huzhou Real Estate Registration Service Center. A live official notice fetched successfully, but bounded HTML inspection exposed no public anonymous parcel viewer/API, schema/CRS, or safe native ID-plus-geometry response. Direct retrieval of official PDF hosts failed DNS resolution; no certificate exception was used.
